title: Mean time to detect — identity compromise
summary: Time between the earliest authentication-event evidence on the principal and the moment the impossible-travel detection fires. Lower is better.

target.rationale: ENISA good-practice baseline for credential-access detections.

measurement.formula: p95( detection.first_fire_time - telemetry.first_event_time ) over identity-compromise incidents within window.

inputs.name: first_event
inputs.description: earliest OCSF authentication event for the principal

inputs.name: first_fire
inputs.description: earliest detection firing correlated to the principal
